blocks.text: KYIV, Ukraine — A Russian drone slammed into a busy railway platform in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro Thursday, killing at least 14 people in what President Volodymyr Zelensky called a “horrific” attack that demands action by Kyiv’s allies. The strike came as Ukraine and Russia kept to a fragile local ceasefire in the ravaged city of Oleshky — under Russian occupation since 2022 and where residents have faced months of food, water and medicine shortages. While the truce held into a third day, at least 20 people were killed and more than 70 people injured, according to local officials, in […]...
